OCR components included for browser-local image processing.
Tesseract.js 6.0.1: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js
Tesseract.js-core 6.0.0: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core
Licenses and bundled dependency notices are included in this directory.
English and Spanish fast traineddata: https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast (Apache License 2.0).
Downloaded from https://tessdata.projectnaptha.com/4.0.0_fast/.
Images are not uploaded by these components.
